adrs: Use one provider-neutral server-side model adapter for bounded requirement analysis and ReportDesign proposal. A qualified configured Azure OpenAI/OpenAI-compatible profile may be the first real runtime; no provider, deployment, model version or region is selected by this contract, and no automatic fallback is permitted.

No environment-, provider-, customer-, deployment-, capability- or policy-dependent runtime value may be hardcoded in application logic. Provider selection, type/protocol profile, endpoint/base URL, deployment/model identifier, configurable API version, region, model vision/structured-output capabilities, call/token/time budgets, retry and timeout limits, upload file types and size/count limits, feature flags, reference-material capability flags, storage/runtime endpoints, environment-specific URLs and customer/tenant policy choices must come from validated server-side configuration or governed tenant/product configuration as appropriate. Code may implement supported protocols, contracts and validation behaviour, but must not embed deployment choices or business/customer-specific configuration.

Missing or invalid required runtime configuration fails closed with a truthful capability/configuration error. No silent compiled-in default provider, model, endpoint, region, budget, retry policy or customer rule is permitted. Automated tests may supply deterministic test configuration, but test values must never become production defaults.

Only server-selected, purpose-limited original and durable additional requirements, accepted prior answers, qualified CSV/XLSX schema/context, applicable governed knowledge and supported reference material may be sent for pre-confirmation analysis; post-confirmation design uses the exact confirmed contract and its bound context. Never send credentials, authorization internals or unrelated company/customer data. Model output cannot assert access, confirmation, review, eligibility or validation.

Provider calls require explicit server-side configuration, capability qualification, configured call/token/time budgets and bounded retry policy; missing limits or qualification fail closed. Credentials stay server-side, are never logged or returned, and no external calls occur in automated tests.

The existing canonical TypeScript clarification contracts, ReportDesign schema, normalization, guardrails, compiler and candidate validation remain downstream authority through bounded server-side bridge operations. Do not create a second compiler, browser model call or fixed obligation-to-visual recipe.

Persist design-proposal attempts, safe failure categories, provider/model/prompt/configuration and usage provenance, exact context digests, validation evidence and immutable eligible design bytes. Extend the existing reviewed_design_id record/command contract with an explicit automatic-eligible origin; never label an automatic design as human expert-reviewed.

The business user confirms exact material meaning, not hidden ReportDesign mechanics. Deterministic validation and current server-derived membership/private-report access decide eligibility; an EXPERT may still submit and review a design under the existing separately recorded path.

Responsive thresholds, spacing and reusable layout values belong in the central design/style system rather than scattered one-off magic values or component overrides. The normal business journey and expert-detail disclosure must retain the same meaning and authority at every supported viewport size.

Treat reference images as untrusted private materials. Semantic image interpretation may be claimed only for an explicitly qualified and tested vision-capable configured runtime; otherwise retain the asset with an honest not-interpreted state and route material dependence to clarification or expert review.

Add a generic typed difference measure only when explicitly supported by exact confirmed operands, deterministic integrity checks and the existing canonical Power BI compiler. Unsupported arithmetic or source facts fail closed; no retail-specific measures, fields, visuals or templates enter production logic.

Rollback disables new provider/design commands without deleting or rewriting requirements, reference objects, design attempts, eligible designs or generation history. Database migration and feature-disable recovery must be tested in isolated data; no destructive production-data rollback is implied.

APBRA-171 remains local/CI development and synthetic-data validation. It does not authorize production deployment, public/customer-data exposure, Power BI Service publishing, credential/gateway automation, Package D takeover or release-approval bypass. A deterministic fake provider proves mechanics only, not intelligent product capability.

acceptance_criteria: An active same-company ordinary EDITOR can complete requirement, data, understanding, clarification only when material, exact confirmation, automatic eligible design, protected build, private download, refresh and durable history without routine EXPERT intervention or raw ReportDesign JSON.

Business-facing copy avoids case, chat/message, raw ReportDesign, schema, digest, deterministic engine and internal contract terminology outside optional permission-respecting expert details; Home has one clear starting composer and the six-stage journey is sticky, responsive, keyboard-operable and truthful.

P0 responsive UX is required for the complete normal business-user journey at representative desktop, laptop, tablet and narrow/mobile viewport classes; no horizontal page overflow, clipped controls, hidden primary actions, overlapping or broken sticky regions, broken cards or tables, inaccessible content or unreadable text may block completion.

The navigation rail, top bar, sticky six-stage journey, report composer, supporting-material upload/drop zone, requirement review, clarification, build/report states, durable history and expert escalation reflow intentionally rather than merely shrinking at narrower viewports.

Long report titles, filenames, field names, validation text and user-entered requirements wrap or truncate deliberately without losing critical meaning or hiding actions; buttons, forms, drop zones and action groups remain keyboard accessible and touch-usable where relevant.

Empty, loading, disabled, success, warning, stale, error and unavailable states use one consistent visual and language system; business terminology and primary action labels remain consistent across Home, report workspace, review, build, current report and history. Expert/technical detail remains progressively disclosed at every viewport size.

Responsive thresholds, spacing and reusable layout values are centralized in the design/style system, not duplicated as one-off magic values; a polished desktop screenshot alone is insufficient P0 acceptance evidence.

Additional requirements persist as original-context-preserving evidence and influence the next interpretation; current context binding, confirmation and design eligibility become stale when material requirement or supporting content changes.

A representative retail fixture with Revenue, Cost, UnitsSold, Store, Region, ProductCategory, Product and SaleDate supports explicit multi-measure/multi-dimension meaning, typed Profit difference and Profit Margin ratio when exact operands are evidenced; SaleID is not offered as a default business dimension and no single-field clarification is asked for already supplied meaning.

CSV/XLSX and private image references have separate types, provenance and qualified capability states. Drop/browse, bounded multi-file selection, progress/errors, removal of uncommitted selections, safe retry of failed uploads and accessible keyboard interaction work without deleting retained evidence, treating an image as calculation data or claiming untested image interpretation.

Provider analysis/design uses only approved, bounded, purpose-limited server context. A missing, disabled, incompatible, failed, over-budget or timed-out profile produces a truthful failure or expert route, never an automatic provider/model/region fallback, fabricated success or unbounded retry.

Every environment-, provider-, customer-, deployment-, capability- or policy-dependent runtime value is resolved from validated server-side or governed tenant/product configuration; missing or invalid required values fail closed with a truthful capability/configuration error, without silent compiled-in deployment, limit or customer-rule defaults.

Expert review is offered for material ambiguity, unsupported or unrealistic intent, explicit user request, applicable governance rule, or failure to produce an eligible automatic design; it is not silently required for an ordinary eligible request.

Only a deterministically eligible candidate from the existing canonical TypeScript contract, normalization, semantic coverage, guardrails, compiler feasibility and candidate checks becomes an immutable AUTO_ELIGIBLE design version; expert-reviewed versions retain separate EXPERT_REVIEWED provenance and authority.

Every automatic design attempt, validation outcome, provider/model/prompt/configuration version, usage observation and safe failure category is durable without persisting secrets or unnecessary raw provider payload; an eligible version binds exact company, report, confirmed contract, request, interpretation, data and reference digests.

The existing opaque reviewed_design_id remains the generation input. Operation-time actor, company, private access, current confirmation, exact context and immutable design digest are rechecked for build, retry, regeneration, history and download; foreign, revoked, stale, tampered and concurrent requests fail closed.

Regeneration creates a new design or build history entry as applicable and never rewrites earlier outputs. Design or generation cancellation/failure is preserved truthfully; provider error cannot corrupt confirmed requirements or existing reports.
No second compiler, browser-authoritative design, hardcoded retail/school/clinic/warehouse rules or visual recipe, fake AI claim, public deployment or Power BI Service publication is introduced.
